messages:
Sofia (CS): NovaEdge week0 follow-up: SOC halted KMS policy approval. Two asks: 1) immutable delivery proof for audit logs into their Splunk (signed manifest + replay), 2) explicit key rotation procedure showing no gaps for 24-month retention. They warned procurement may pause renewals until both are satisfied. tagging @Rina and @Liam.

Liam (Solutions): got it. i can run a replay from a presigned S3 and emit a signed manifest (sha256 per object + timestamp). need staging HEC token and presigned URL.

Rina (Security): i'll draft a KMS policy snippet that restricts decrypt to the forwarder role and a vpce, and include a rotation overlap plan (48h dual-decrypt). will also provide a short attestation template for SOC to sign.

Marco (Ops): ops note: in our internal smoke we saw ~1% drop when HEC returned 503s during bursts. mitigation: checkpointing + idempotency keys + batching jitter. runbook excerpt i'll use:
```
# forwarder config excerpt
max_batch: 120
batch_timeout_ms: 1200
retries: 8
checkpoint_interval: 45s
idempotency: enabled
```

Liam (Solutions): i'll include the verification script that compares s3 counts -> splunk counts and produces the signed manifest. example command i'll use: s3-count && replay && splunk-count && sign-manifest.

Sofia (CS): action items: 1) @Liam request presigned S3 + staging HEC creds by EOD. 2) @Rina post KMS policy + rotation overlap doc by tomorrow AM. 3) @Marco run replay, paste pre/post counts and the signed manifest. tagging @Kai (Renewals)  this is a potential renewal watch until SOC signs off.

infra-bot: Reminder: NovaEdge week0 follow-up meeting scheduled 1727778200 (in ~15m).

Kai (Renewals): acknowledged. marking account as "watch" in CRM. i'll hold renewal outreach pending the PoC and will escalate to execs if SOC remains blocked.

Rina (Security): KMS policy redacted snippet (for review): {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"ForwarderUseOnly","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/nova-forwarder"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceVpc":"vpc-0abc1234"}}}]}

Marco (Ops): once we have the presigned URL i'll run the replay and post counts. i'll also include the runbook diff adding the checkpoint persistence and the idempotency verification script.

Sofia (CS): thanks team  i'll update the customer with Rina's policy + Liam's PoC playbook after Marco posts the replay results. leaving thread open until SOC signoff.
